scope: Freeze candidate structure and label definitions only; this is not authorization to execute DFT or training.

E_input.result: P1/P2 values below are frozen only where supported by C's existing review. Unavailable E-specific sources, IDs, d0, registry, and cell values remain explicit blockers.

scf_thresholds.note: Use project GPAW tolerance semantics; do not represent 1e-5 as a total-energy error bound.

common_dft_method.required_force_outputs: complete per-atom Cartesian forces in eV/angstrom
common_dft_method.stress_policy: save the full stress tensor for every point as a diagnostic; bulk Ti3SiC2 stress may become a training label only after k-mesh and cutoff convergence; do not use vacuum-containing slab stress as a stress label

P1_Ti_C.role_status: candidate only; exact independent parent source not established
P1_Ti_C.source_requirement: Must be a documented, genuinely new parent family, not a relabel, simple displacement, or expansion of already-scored COD 9009647/Kisi 1998 structures. The five existing numerical-control labels retain their roles and are not copied or reclassified here.
P1_Ti_C.atom_mapping: Crystallographic Ti(4f) and C(4f) sites in the chosen parent; exact atom IDs and symmetry/origin mapping must be generated from the source CIF and independently checked before inputs are frozen.
P1_Ti_C.displacement_axis: Cartesian z aligned with the parent crystallographic c axis
P1_Ti_C.cell_policy: fixed parent cell for all four endpoints; move only the mapped atom; no relaxation

kpoint_policy.final_mesh: HOLD pending a same-geometry convergence comparison; these are planned meshes, not verified results

label_policy.stress: save; use as a label only after convergence
label_policy.split: all four structures remain in this one DEV parent family

P2_Ag_Si.role_status: candidate only; no executable structures frozen
P2_Ag_Si.source_requirement: Must be a documented new interface parent family, not the already-scored 52-atom Ag-Si family or a registry/distance perturbation of that family.
P2_Ag_Si.registry: UNRESOLVED; E table and source structure are unavailable

d0.definition: Reference plane-to-plane gap between the mean z coordinate of the outermost terminating Si layer and the mean z coordinate of the nearest Ag layer, for the selected termination, registry, and in-plane cell.
d0.reference_basis: Must be supplied by the source-qualified relaxed interface or a cited reproducible source; do not derive a numerical value from a schematic or adhesion-energy table alone.

distance_endpoints.construction: Rigidly translate the whole Ag slab by -0.10 angstrom along z relative to the fixed Ti3SiC2 slab; preserve lateral registry and all internal coordinates.
Rigidly translate the whole Ag slab by +0.10 angstrom along z relative to the fixed Ti3SiC2 slab; preserve lateral registry and all internal coordinates.

cell_and_vacuum.in_plane_cell: UNRESOLVED until the source geometry, strain match, and registry are verified
cell_and_vacuum.cell_policy_for_pair: same fixed cell and PBC for d0-0.10, d0, and d0+0.10 endpoints
cell_and_vacuum.vacuum_convergence_test: repeat the same geometry with +4 angstrom vacuum before freezing final slab cell
cell_and_vacuum.dipole_correction: apply in z for the asymmetric slab; verify implementation against the approved GPAW setup

kpoint_policy.final_mesh: HOLD pending same-geometry convergence; candidate meshes are not verified

label_policy.stress: save as diagnostic only; do not use vacuum-cell stress as a training label
label_policy.split: both endpoints and the d0 reference belong to the same DEV parent family

AG_SI_DEV_SOURCE_REFERENCE.title: First principles electronic structure of coincidence site epitaxial Ag/Si(111) interface
AG_SI_DEV_SOURCE_REFERENCE.use: Ag/Ti3SiC2 Si-termination DEV design-method reference only

design_evidence.matching_idea: four Ag(111) surface unit cells on three Si(111) surface unit cells; paper reports about 0.3% residual mismatch/effective Ag strain
design_evidence.illustrated_registry: every fifth Ag atom directly above the fourth Si atom; a cited example, not a systematic registry-energy ranking
design_evidence.distance_caveat: local bond lengths, not a plane-to-plane d0; not transferable as target Ag/Ti3SiC2 d0
design_evidence.construction_method: six Si(111) bilayers, one Ag monolayer, H-passivated opposite Si side, fully relaxed coordinates; VASP/PAW, CA-PZ LDA and PBE in some GGA calculations; 500 eV cutoff; reported 4x4x2 and, for a buried supercell LDA calculation, 5x5x1 k mesh

source_artifact.provided_filename: First principles electronic structure of coincide.pdf

AG_SI_DEV_SOURCE_REFERENCE.verification_note: Citation and the listed design details were checked against the user-provided primary PDF, title page and pp. 1313-1315 (Section 2, Section 3.1, Figs. 1 and 3). The paper does not provide machine-readable target Ag/Ti3SiC2 coordinates or target per-atom force labels. The numerical details apply to Ag/Si(111), not the Ti3SiC2 target.
